description: Agent Coordination: submit a multi-agent work plan as recorded: optionally the agents in it, each with its id and the role it holds, and each task with its id, its title, the agents that own it, the outputs or deliverables it produces (the task itself when none is named), the outputs of other tasks it needs and the tasks it waits for. The signed report lists every task with its owners, the tasks it waits on and the inputs nobody produces, every deliverable with the agents that own it (single owner, contested or unowned) and every circular wait, and names a plan that cannot run as written: tasks with no owner, deliverables two agents own, circular dependencies and tasks that need an output no task in the plan produces; then dependencies on tasks not in the plan, owners not among the listed agents, listed agents with no task and agents with no role, with the fix for each. This reads how several collaborating agents divide one job: one principal handing work to one agent is wever_delegation-scope-check, a chain of delegations is wever_delegation-chain-check and one handoff record between two parties is wever_handoff-record-check. Verdict plan_unworkable, plan_gaps, plan_unverified or plan_workable. POST /api/coordination-plan-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-coordination-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-coordination/.

role.description: The role the agent holds in the plan, such as researcher or reviewer.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

after.description: The ids of the tasks it waits for.

needs.description: The outputs of other tasks it needs.

owners.description: The ids of the agents that own the task.

produces.description: The outputs or deliverables the task produces; the task itself when left out.

name: wever_coordination-plan-check
title: Coordination plan check
